assessment_scope: Formal lifecycle/manual independent Proposal Review for 2026-09-17-retire-feature-format-support at merged baseline 5822e0e6. Assesses direction sufficiency, initial-intent preservation, compatibility dispositions and embedded feasibility, not detailed Design or deletion approval. PRR1G assembly; scope_budget_context true, vision_exception_context and standing_artifact_context false.
independence_basis: Independent delegated reviewer /root/focused_proposal_review inspected the complete new proposal and standing authority plus bounded implementation evidence. Parent author prepared this proposal. Reviewer authored no proposal, Design, implementation or test changes; only this assessment record is written. Earlier focused-testing approvals are not reused as retirement approval.
limitations: This approval establishes direction sufficiency for authorized Design reconciliation only. It does not approve detailed contracts, exact deletion lists, implementation, tests, final verification or PR readiness.

Current feature/proof support remains until reviewed coherent implementation; this proposal and review do not mutate customer artifacts, rewrite historical evidence or authorize publication/version selection.

Design must reconcile transitive packaged methods and CLI spec-location/configuration consumers, specify proportionate unsupported-input and no-write behavior, and preserve current compact/model/catalog/record safety. Delivery and later reviews must prove those boundaries.

Historical path/window retirement and unrelated compatibility families remain with the preserved original initiative. No exhaustive compatibility inventory or execution of the future reduced suite is claimed.
rationale: Challenge and goals: pass. The currently published feature amendment/proof-map methods and accepted structural formats create real ongoing maintenance beyond the selected living-Design workflow. The goals address the user request to stop specs support and simplify tests by retiring actual accepted behavior and its exclusive costs together, while preserving meaningful current-model proof.

Scope and scope-budget gate: pass. The proposal separates feature/proof operation, structural dispatch and advertised spec location from source interpretation, compact boundary reasoning, generic record inspection, record safety and current model/catalog validation. The five archive paths, examples-prefix handling, flat aliases and tooling-path transitions remain supported in this slice with a named original-initiative follow-up. Synthetic versions/names are correctly classified as fixture values rather than compatibility promises. No hidden wholesale removal of historical directories or old-looking tests is authorized.

Principle and direction: pass. Current outcomes govern retained support; retirement reconciles exclusive instructions, generated resource distribution, dispatch and test maintenance. Unsupported-operation explanation and unchanged customer files preserve authority. Scoped adoption may transfer requirements to living Designs only with project authority; the installed package cannot silently convert customer artifacts.

Feasibility: pass. Exactly one embedded assessment identifies concrete mechanisms, constraints and no known Design blocker. Bounded source inspection confirms validate_feature_record, validate_proof_map and accepted specs dispatch alongside surviving model validation; the native aggregate separates feature/path/adoption/model/command/catalog groups. The resource manifest independently declares compact-core, feature-authoring and proof; the CLI bundles a spec artifact location. These facts support targeted removal and coherent consumer reconciliation without a new subsystem. This evidence is plausibility, not a completed exhaustive deletion inventory.

Material impact and vision alignment: pass; aligned. The proposal explicitly discloses withdrawal of a previously supported customer workflow, release communication and the living-Design alternative, retaining historical judgments and prohibiting automatic customer-file changes. This supports the vision of durable traceability and understandable current reliance while preserving recoverable history. References to specifications in the vision describe engineering artifacts, not a permanent promise of this specific companion format.

Downstream authority and requested decision: pass. Design retains precise accepted population, diagnostics, source interpretation and failure/no-write behavior; Delivery retains exact deletion scope, proof allocation and recovery. Release version/publication remain separately owned. Proposal approval supplies neither implementation permission nor proof that the broader compatibility program is complete.

Scope-preservation result: pass. The initial no-specs direction, bold removal of obsolete tests, durable model coverage and preserved original workspace are visible. Deferral of independent historical change-range policy is explicit and justified. No missing owner decision prevents judgment of this selected feature-format direction.
summary: The bounded withdrawal of feature-spec and companion proof-format operations is clear, feasible and aligned with the selected living-Design direction, with customer impact and retained compatibility explicitly bounded.
